title: Odile and the Garden
author: Ansel Quintana
blurb: Odile Villalobos, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
